topics.title: Discussion about AI intelligence and toolkits

claims.text: AI systems are not intrinsically intelligent; their complex abilities come from toolkits and prepared solutions.
People do not need AI to be truly smart because humans themselves lack understanding of it.
Testing a 2022‑2023 AI with modern toolkits like opencode may show limited performance due to small context windows in older models.
InstinctGPT compared a ~3B model with GPT‑3 175B using external runtime and tools, showing toolkits give large gains but cannot replace missing base model abilities.
Older models were trained on everything without understanding, while modern models try to extract maximal performance from fewer parameters and are sometimes fine‑tuned for specific tasks.
